# Whistleblowing & Incident Management Software | EthicsPoint

Enterprise whistleblowing and incident management software
NAVEX One EthicsPoint Professional is the industry's leading AI-powered whistleblowing and incident management software for enterprise organizations to meet multinational regulatory requirements and demonstrate global accountability.

Key Statistics
- 13,000+ customers worldwide trust NAVEX
- 9x ROI achievable through efficiency and cost savings
- 7,505 hours saved through streamlined report intake and investigation (based on 6,000-person organization with 100 annual reports)

Core Capabilities
- Trusted AI-supported channels: The system guides employees and third parties through reporting with Nira AI assistance ("Nira for Intake") for structured information gathering, with multilingual support and machine translations for report details.
- Configurable case management: Organizations can automate assignments, escalations, and design custom workflows matching regional needs; role-based access controls prevent implicated parties from accessing sensitive information.
- Data intelligence: pattern identification across cases, AI-assisted analysis for related reports (surfacing repeat behaviors), and Power BI dashboard integration.
- Connected compliance: integrates with HR, risk, and policy systems to provide unified visibility and audit-ready data.
- Reporting accessibility: 24/7 web, phone, and mobile access; machine translations; anonymous or named reporting; coverage for contractors and suppliers.

Notable Users
